The MF-105 family: MF-105 MuRF (designed by Bob Moog, 2004-05) has eight band-pass filters spanning 200 Hz to 3.4 kHz; MF-105B Bass MuRF has a 110 Hz low-pass/shelf plus seven resonant filters between 160 Hz and 1.8 kHz; the MF-105M MIDI MuRF combines both voicings in one box (FREQ switch), adds MIDI, stereo outputs and a free Pattern Editor.

ENVELOPE morphs the shape of all eight filter envelopes; manual landmarks: 0 = choppy with shortened decay; 2 = sharp attack with quick smooth fade (basic setting); 5 = equal attack and decay (smooth tremolo-like); 6 = long attack and decay so filters crossfade; 8 = smooth fast attack with abrupt decay ('backwards'); the reviewers add that beyond that the shape inverts. Envelope times scale with RATE (slower rate = longer envelopes).
